learning_outcomes.text: Practical preparation of students by providing them with technical and managerial knowledge, with which to develop applied and technical thinking skills.
Preparation of the student for the labor market, by acquiring practical experience in the targeted field.
Knowledge of how engineering activities are carried out taking into account requirements, work instructions, and deadlines.

syllabus_topics: General information regarding the economic unit / enterprise (enterprise specialization; general plan of the enterprise, location of sections, workshops, warehouses)

General characteristics of production sections (name and specialization of production sections; assortment and characteristics of finished products; number and names of technological lines; storage of raw materials, semi-finished products, finished products)
Familiarization with software packages dedicated to a specific activity of the enterprise, depending on the visited economic agents
Practical activities: Visits to various profile companies
assessment_rules: The practice concludes with a colloquium where the student will present a practice notebook, detailing the resolution of the practice theme/project. The supervisor, accompanied by another specialized teacher, will award a 'promoted/failed' grade. The assessment is based on 1/2 accumulated knowledge and 1/2 practice notebook. Minimum performance requires presence at company visits, verified by an attendance sheet, and presentation of the practice notebook during the colloquium.
